==Notes==
* The arrow leaves the bow {{1/4}} seconds into this skill's activation, as [[attack skill]]s hit halfway through their stated [[activation time]].
* Deals additional damage even if skill interruption is prevented.
* If used to interrupt a target under the effect of [[Daze]], the Daze will interrupt the target before the skill does, and no additional damage will be dealt.
